brief: Complete the external landscaping for a proposed duplex in Ermington, including turf, garden areas, decorative pebbles, fencing, gates, edging, letterboxes and clotheslines. During the works, the scope expanded to include a boundary retaining wall with excavation, drainage and structural-engineer sign-off.
challenge: The site had a significant fall and the boundary condition required a 41 m retaining wall up to 1.2 m high, soil removal and access to both the client and neighbouring property. The wall also required drainage plus structural engineer design, site inspection and approval.
approach: Estate coordinated the earthworks, soil relocation and off-site spoil removal with the retaining-wall installation, drainage and engineering approval, while delivering the wider duplex landscape package. The completed scope included 66 m of Colorbond fencing, four gates, Sir Walter Buffalo turf, decorative pebbles and garden finishes.
technical: Retaining-wall variation: 41 m long and up to 1.2 m high using plain grey Ezzy Fit composite sleepers with galvanized steel posts. Agline and aggregate backfill were included for drainage, with structural engineer design, site inspection and sign-off.
outcome: A complete duplex landscape package was delivered across, including turf, 66 m of fencing, four gates, garden and pebble finishes, and a 41 m engineered boundary retaining wall. The client has remained in contact after the project and has provided multiple referrals.
